rationale: Four major findings across the two new scheduler edit pages: (1) success toast says 'Integration updated successfully' in a scheduler context; (2) when the setting is not found the page renders blank with no feedback or redirect; (3) fetchSetting has no catch block so network errors produce an unhandled rejection and a silent blank page; (4) query params are cast as string without validation so a direct URL access or missing param silently passes 'undefined' to the store. No spec/story artifact was available (sdlc-light no-spec round). Two deferred items: inherited (resp as any).error pattern matches the source integration pages; route absolute/relative path style inconsistency is cosmetic and functionally equivalent in react-router 7.
follow_ups: CR-001: Change toaster.info('Integration updated successfully') to 'Scheduler updated successfully' in both EditUserSchedulerPage.tsx and EditProjectSchedulerPage.tsx
CR-002: Add else branch after if (foundSetting) in both pages: toaster.error + navigateBack(SCHEDULERS) when setting is null
CR-003: Add catch block in fetchSetting in both pages to handle network errors with toaster.error + navigateBack(SCHEDULERS)
CR-004: Add early guard at top of fetchSetting before calling store: check query.project_name/credential_type/alias are truthy, else toaster.error + navigateBack(SCHEDULERS)

standards_review.notes: Apache 2.0 headers present in both new files
No XSS, injection, or secrets issues introduced

findings.problem: Success toast reads 'Integration updated successfully' — copy-pasted from the integration page, wrong context for a scheduler page.
findings.impact: Misleading user-facing feedback in the scheduler flow. Same defect on line 58 of EditProjectSchedulerPage.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Change to toaster.info('Scheduler updated successfully') in both files.

findings.problem: When findUserSetting / findProjectSetting returns falsy (no matching record, stale query params), the if (foundSetting) block is skipped. loading becomes false, setting stays null. Page renders blank shell with only Cancel — no error message and no redirect.
findings.impact: Silent broken state; user has no indication the scheduler setting could not be found. Same defect in EditProjectSchedulerPage.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Add else branch: toaster.error('Scheduler setting not found'); navigateBack(SCHEDULERS).

findings.problem: fetchSetting uses try/finally with no catch. If the store call throws (network failure, HTTP error), the exception becomes an unhandled promise rejection. The spinner disappears (finally runs) but no error is shown.
findings.impact: User sees a blank page after a network error with no feedback. Same defect in EditProjectSchedulerPage.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Add catch block: toaster.error('Failed to load scheduler settings'); navigateBack(SCHEDULERS).

findings.problem: query.project_name, query.credential_type, and query.alias are cast as string without validation. If any param is absent (direct URL access, bookmark, navigation bug), undefined is passed to the store find call.
findings.impact: Silent misuse — find predicate never matches, combines with CR-002 to produce a blank page. Same in EditProjectSchedulerPage.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Add early guard at the top of fetchSetting: if (!query.project_name || !query.credential_type || !query.alias) { toaster.error('Missing required parameters'); navigateBack(SCHEDULERS); return; }
